name: M7.DefaultQuery.noLogical_policy
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (q : M7.DefaultQuery.Query) (base placed : M7.Action.Recipe N), (M7.DefaultQuery.needsDistance q → M7.DefaultQuery.distance placed = none → ¬ M7.DefaultQuery.feasible q base placed) ∧ (q.distanceFloor = none → M7.DefaultQuery.Coordinate.negativeDistance ∉ q.objectives → (M7.DefaultQuery.feasible q base placed ↔ M7.DefaultQuery.valid N q ∧ M7.DefaultQuery.dimension placed ∈ q.dimensions ∧ M7.DefaultQuery.sectorTest q base placed ∧ (match q.localityCap with | none => True | some cap => M7.DefaultQuery.locality placed ≤ cap) ∧ (match q.radiusCap with | none => True | some cap => M7.DefaultQuery.radius placed ≤ cap)))
guidance: Unfold feasible and needsDistance. A demanded distance conflicts with Option.isSome none. When floor is none and no negativeDistance coordinate is requested, both distance guards reduce to True; all other query tests remain. This explicitly permits NoLogical when no numerical distance is requested, and assigns no infinite distance. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; retain exact target and default limits.
